removedPerRootExecution: Three callable wrappers, two temporary parameter-name arrays and three signature catalog lock/lookups. Signatures were already interned; mutable builtin dictionaries and object/type/exception graphs remain private.
isolationEvidence: DelegateBoundArgumentsCallable holds readonly signature/delegates. Len/Repr/Ascii are static methods taking the current ExecutionContext; no captured run state.
BuiltinCallable hierarchy cache writes require BuildBuiltinTypeHierarchy success, which requires BuiltinTypeBaseNames membership. These three names are absent.
NewSlot writes in TryGetTypeNewSlot require BuiltinTypeBaseNames membership. Inherited __new__ resolves through the existing shared builtin-function type, not this slot.
Unbound method cache writes require builtin type membership; scalar descriptor cache is limited to int/float/range. Type-method switch has only dict/bytes/str/int/bool/float entries.
__self__ resolves the current caller's imported module. __class__ uses the existing shared builtin-function type. Neither stores the current context on the callable.
No IPyMutableAttributes implementation was added; attempted callable mutation is rejected. No new cache, callable class, binder route, scope or dependency.
contract: Fixed trusted metadata lives in host/control headroom. Cross-execution callable identity can become stable; in-run identity, per-run state isolation and retained-result funding stay unchanged.
limitations: This does not add asynchronous protocol dispatch inside len/rendering, remove other per-run metadata, change scalar representation or establish a runtime speedup.
validation: Five public controls pass on the unchanged baseline and candidate: sequential sync/async metadata/type/module/state isolation and retained results; overlapping suspended/cancelled host execution under a shared budget; sync/async name shadowing isolation. Reuse full ordinary white-box, focused public and governed regressions.
fixtureCorrections: Initial test used an invalid mutable object builtin, expected inherited __new__ absent and expected a new cancelled output file. Corrected against Python behavior/host semantics before production change; all failed receipts preserved. Initial enum name compile error corrected; no tests used that failed build.
timingGate: One existing control.empty.control warm diagnostic only. Initial catalog selection typo stopped setup before any timing. No new producer or repeat, no speedup claim from inconclusive samples.
